description: fp-index/2. Concatenate the shards in order into one blob. Sections (byte offsets into the blob): bucket_bits = uint32 little-endian [nbuckets+1], bit offset into `stream` where each bucket starts (last entry = end). stream = bit stream, MSB first in each byte. A hash h = (f1<<15)|(f2<<6)|dt lives in bucket h>>6. For each distinct hash in a bucket, in ascending h&63: 6 bits h&63; n = postings as Elias gamma (floor(log2 n) zero bits, then n in floor(log2 n)+1 bits); then n global frames G ascending, each as v = G - prev - 1 (prev starts at -1) Rice-coded with k = largest k such that n*2^k <= universe: (v>>k) one bits, a zero bit, the low k bits of v. A global frame maps to reference r = last ref whose start <= G, anchor frame t = G - start. Votes are on (r, floor((t - query_t)/2)), exactly as app/fingerprint.py match(); the runner-up is the best count for a DIFFERENT song (refs[].song_id), as server.py calls match(group=...). refs[].song_id / via / live follow server.py canonical() and app/library/refs.json; refs[].shift (recording time - lyric time, 0 unless aligned) and aligned (false = a different arrangement: no clock) come from app/library/ref_align.json; refs[].excluded = unauthorised, never votes (fingerprint.set_exclude).
